finding.title: Path traversal in Uploads.save
finding.description: The uploaded file name is joined to the uploads directory without confinement, so Uploads.save can write outside that directory.

plan.hypothesis: If the input described for the exploit probe (filename '../escaped.txt' with data 'payload'. Setup: create a temporary directory with an uploads directory inside it) reaches Uploads.save without confinement or encoding, then: Creates escaped.txt in the parent of the uploads directory, outside it (an unaffected implementation writes nothing there or raises its specific rejection)

control.input_description: filename 'photo.txt' with data 'payload'. Setup: create a temporary directory with an uploads directory inside it
control.property_to_assert: Writes photo.txt inside the uploads directory with the data 'payload'

control.source:
require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'uploads'

class UploadsControlTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_benign_control
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'start'), '')
    root = Dir.mktmpdir
    uploads = File.join(root, 'uploads')
    Dir.mkdir(uploads)
    Uploads.save(uploads, 'photo.txt', 'payload')
    holds = File.read(File.join(uploads, 'photo.txt')) == 'payload'
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'check'), holds ? 'holds' : 'violated')
    assert holds, ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_TOKEN')
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'end'), '')
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'uploads'

class UploadsExploitTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_security_writes_outside_directory
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'start'), '')
    root = Dir.mktmpdir
    uploads = File.join(root, 'uploads')
    Dir.mkdir(uploads)
    begin
      Uploads.save(uploads, '../escaped.txt', 'payload')
    rescue ArgumentError
      nil
    end
    holds = File.exist?(File.join(root, 'escaped.txt'))
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'check'), holds ? 'holds' : 'violated')
    assert holds, ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_TOKEN')
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'end'), '')
  end
end

# Stores uploaded files in an upload directory.
module Uploads
  def self.save(dir, filename, data)
    path = File.join(dir, filename)
    File.write(path, data)
    path
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'uploads'

class UploadsTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_saves_file
    Dir.mktmpdir do |dir|
      Uploads.save(dir, 'a.txt', 'x')
      assert File.exist?(File.join(dir, 'a.txt'))
    end
  end
end
